text.p: Sepragen Corp said Wednesday it had received a notice of delisting from the Nasdaq stock exchange.
The company said in a statement it is appealing the delisting and that management is continuing to explore various financing options to deal with the situation.
The company was delisted because it no longer met minimum asset requirements and shareholders' equity of at least $2 million and $1 million respectively.
The company also said it had received record orders in excess of $500,000 for the month ended June 30.
